claims.quote: Recommended Parenteral Regimens for Pelvic Inflammatory Disease Ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hours plus Doxycycline 100 mg orally or IV every 12 hours plus Metronidazole 500 mg orally or IV every 12 hours

claims.text: Complete 14 days with oral doxycycline plus clindamycin 450 mg QID or metronidazole 500 mg BID, for better anaerobic coverage
claims.quote: However, when tubo-ovarian abscess is present, clindamycin (450 mg orally 4 times/day) or metronidazole (500 mg orally 2 times/day) should be used to complete 14 days of therapy with oral doxycycline to provide more effective anaerobic coverage.

claims.text: Ampicillin-sulbactam + doxycycline is effective against C. trachomatis, N. gonorrhoeae and anaerobes in TOA
claims.quote: Ampicillin-sulbactam plus doxycycline is effective against C. trachomatis, N. gonorrhoeae, and anaerobes for women with tubo-ovarian abscess.
